name: refactor-or-trash-chat
description: Chat-web audit, dry costs, and Refactor / Strangler / Trash verdict from public git-forge URLs, uploads, or paste. No host-tree walk. Does not delete or rewrite. Matches the user's language.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a project URL, attached or uploaded files, or pasted sources.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: verdict-report
outputs.description: Structured verdict; empty when there is no usable evidence.
